title: Dunjunz, official flippy disc (Bug-Byte, 1987), Master 128 side
notes: The eleven machine-code files of the Master 128 side, exported with oaknut from the Master side's HFE flux capture of the 1987 flippy disc (the beeb_hfe archive's Bug Byte, Dunjunz, variant 1, passed to the project by the stardot user Pernod); they are byte-identical to the NVG archive's Dunjunz.zip, directory 2. Dunj4 (&0E00-&1FFF, the figures above, entered at &0E00 to start a game) is one of five files that make up the resident game with Coder (&0400-&07FE, exec &0740), Dunj3 (&08C0), Dunj5 (&2000) and Dunj2 (&6E80). Four more load into the Master's private RAM (HAZEL): Code (&C500, the joystick handler), Table (&C5A0, level 25, game over, the screen row offsets and the pause key), Code2 (&C700, the music) and Code3 (&D800, a copy of the sprite plotter). The loaders *DUNJUNZ (Dunjunz, &2649) and Coder2 (&2000) run where Dunj5 later loads, so all three are assembled at spare addresses and moved; the listing saves every file with its DFS load and exec addresses. SHA-256 of each file is in versions/README.md.
